decisions.reason: As an established environmental sensing module that still fits the firm's modular platform well, it is worth keeping unless accumulated demand evidence has turned clearly negative, which is not indicated here.
Because it is the current generation of a core voltage measurement module replacing an older version, it is highly likely to remain part of the standard platform offering.
The MQTT proxy is a low-cost software complement that broadens connectivity for the installed hardware base, so its option value remains high relative to its carrying cost.
The CAN bus interface continues to support relevant industrial and embedded use cases for German customers, making it a strategically useful module to retain.
The CO2 sensor module remains a plausible and complementary sensing option whose market potential appears sufficient to justify continued availability despite some niche and component-risk exposure.
